name: Usage meters
summary: Budget, seats and credit as three meters, with the forecast hatched past what is used and alert thresholds marked on the bar.
use: on a billing or usage page, for limits that can run out
a11y: Each bar has role meter with its value and label; the forecast and thresholds are also said in the text under it.

use_when: a plan or account summary where two to three limits sit side by side and one may run out before the period ends
avoid_when: a trend over time rather than a share of a limit: use bar-chart
headline numbers with no limit to run out: use kpi-strip
more than three limits: the wide layout holds three columns

parts.name: meters
parts.what: one limit: its label and status, the used amount, the bar and a note

parts.name: label
parts.what: what the limit is, and a short status such as '80% used'

parts.name: alert
parts.what: a warning chip, for example the forecast going over budget

parts.name: amount
parts.what: the used amount, large, followed by 'of' the limit

parts.name: bar
parts.what: the meter: used fill, optional lighter forecast run and threshold ticks

parts.name: note
parts.what: one line on alerts, prices or when it resets

empty.how: with no usage yet, show each meter at 0% with a note such as 'Nothing used this month'; with no limits at all, show empty-state

loading.how: keep the sections and show an empty track with a muted block in place of the amount

error.how: if usage cannot be read, replace the bar with the note 'Usage not available' and put an alert-banners line above the card

disabled.how: for a limit that does not apply on this plan, grey the label and leave the track empty with a note

overflow.how: the three meters sit in columns on a wide screen and stack in one column below that

long_text.how: the label row wraps the alert chip under the label; the chip itself never wraps
